description_en: Creates a data backfill workflow by calling CreateDagComplement
description_zh: 调用CreateDagComplement创建补数据工作流
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-dag-complement --project-env PROD --start-biz-date 2020-05-20_00:00:00 --name xm_test --root-node-id 1234 --include-node-ids 74324,74325 --parallelism false --end-biz-date 2020-05-21_00:00:00 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDagComplement

parameters.help_en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

PROD: production environment.
DEV: development environment
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，包括PROD和DEV
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en:
The start business date for the data backfill.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. Example: `2020-05-20 00:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
补数据的起始业务日期。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2020-05-20 00:00:00`
parameters.name: start_biz_date

parameters.help_en: The ID of the root node for the data backfill
parameters.name: root_node_id

parameters.help_en: The list of included node IDs. If you want to backfill data for only one node, the node must be included in includeNodeIds
parameters.help_zh: 包含的节点ID列表。如果只补一个节点的数据，该节点需要在includeNodeIds中
parameters.name: include_node_ids

parameters.help_en: Optional. The list of node IDs to exclude from the data backfill
parameters.help_zh: 可选参数，排除无需补数据的节点ID列表
parameters.name: exclude_node_ids

parameters.help_en:
Optional. The start time of the task. This parameter is required for hourly scheduled tasks.

Format: `HH:mm:ss`. Example: `00:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
可选参数，任务的开始时间。小时调度任务需要设置该参数。

格式示例为 `HH:mm:ss`，例如 `00:00:00`
parameters.name: biz_begin_time

parameters.help_en:
Optional. The end time of the task. This parameter is required for hourly scheduled tasks.

Format: `HH:mm:ss`. Example: `23:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
可选参数，小时调度任务需要，任务的结束时间

格式示例为 `HH:mm:ss`，例如 `23:00:00`
parameters.name: biz_end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether tasks can execute concurrently
parameters.name: parallelism

parameters.help_en:
The end business date for the data backfill.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. Example: `2020-05-21 00:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
补数据的结束业务日期。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2020-05-21 00:00:00`
parameters.name: end_biz_date

parameters.help_en: A JSON string in which the key is the node ID and the value is the actual parameter value
parameters.help_zh: 传入一个 json 字符串，Key为节点 ID，Value为参数实际值
parameters.name: node_params

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
